rollback_or_recovery_observation: The accepted store, segment bytes, manifest, triage history and loss accounting survived a real close/reopen of the C05 store and C17/C18 segment writer and an independent copied restore directory. A second run against the same state directory failed explicitly and left the accepted manifest unchanged, so the harness cannot overwrite newer accepted state with an old backup. The negative cases are repeatable with the same typed outcomes.
